 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Green Bay Packers announced an unfortunate update on Micah Parsons on Friday. He is inching closer to returning to action but the team made a decision about his immediate future.
 The star pass rusher has yet to make his season debut after sustaining an ACL injury last December. He landed with the Packers in August 2025 via a trade from the Dallas Cowboys in exchange for defensive tackle Kenny Clark and two first-round draft picks. Parsons has established himself as one of the best players at his position and is a three-time first-team All-Pro and five-time Pro Bowler.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement He has recorded 297 combined tackles consisting of 106 assisted and 191 solo efforts in his career. Parsons also has 65.0 sacks, 75 tackles for loss and 11 forced fumbles under his name.
 Green Bay Packers defensive lineman Micah Parsons (1) during the game against the Arizona Cardinals at Lambeau Field.
 Packers Reveal Micah Parsons' Week 9 status
 Green Bay revealed that Parsons won't be available to play on Sunday. The team has a Week 9 showdown with the New England Patriots at Gillette Stadium. Zaire Franklin, Travis Glover, Sean Rhyan and Josh Whyle are also all listed as out .
 The Packers opened Parsons' practice window on Wednesday. They have 21 days to activate him to their 53-man roster, proving that he is just a few more practices away from returning to the field. He is a game changer and will give the team a huge boost on defense.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Green Bay is 5-3 this season and is coming off a 27-19 win over the Carolina Panthers in Week 8. The team has also won four of its last five assignments. However, the Packers remain at the bottom of the NFC North as all four teams have winning records. The good news is they have momentum on their side and will play their Week 10 game at Lambeau Field. Parsons and Co. will the have a bye week, making it likely that he sees action by Week 11 versus the Los Angeles Rams.
